ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used only while you're recording a note, so you can capture a task by speaking instead of typing.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Used to turn the note you just spoke into a task. Nothing is recorded in the background.
ios.NSContactsUsageDescription: Used only when you choose a contact to add to People. The One Thing never reads your address book on its own.
